drafted_from: workflow row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (input_schema and the research, briefing, study, insight, share steps with their submit shapes); read from the row's words, no test runs it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:research-brief-and-study on the subject: how small bakeries get repeat customers, for pursuit:example-bakery; write me a briefing, quiz me, and share nothing until I approve the words."
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Pick the subject in plain words (a goal's title, a topic, a person or a place); add pursuit_id when it serves one of your goals, space_id for the community where an approved insight may go, and since_briefing (like /Briefings/<subject>/2026-11-06.md) to get only what changed.
2. Say "Run workflow:research-brief-and-study". The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run and works the steps research, briefing, study, insight, share.
3. At research, at least 5 sources actually read come back, each with its address, kind, title, an exact quote and when it was read; sources it could not read are listed as unread, never guessed.
4. Read the briefing saved at /Briefings/<subject>/<today>.md, then answer the 3 to 5 questions from memory in your own words; an unanswered question is kept and asked again in the next briefing.
5. Say whether the one insight holds; only if you approve its exact words is it shared in your community or published as a public page.
